mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate signals an improving labor market, which increases consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE drops > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts signals a weakening demand for new homes, which is a leading indicator of a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where HOUST drops > 10% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO shows an increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL), it indicates a real tightening of monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase significantly and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals a strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances where RSAFS increases > 5% in 1 month.
